title: Elevation Watersports
specs: Must be 21 years old with a valid driver’s license and credit card
Complete and sign rental agreement at time of rental
First time jet-skiers and novices must demonstrate safe operation
All children under 13 must wear USCG approved life jackets on boats
Jet ski operators must wear USCG approved life jackets
Boat capacity must be strictly adhered to per US Coast Guard standards
includes: Boat, boards, fuel and a captain included with Nautique 210 and G23 rentals
gap: Exact rental durations for hourly and daily rentals not fully detailed
blurb: Guests rent boats or jet skis to use on local lakes. Rentals include orientation and safety instructions. Some rentals include a captain and fuel.
extraNote: Full refund up to 30 days before rental, 50% refund 30-14 days before, no refund within 14 days · $99 cancellation processing fee on all refunds · No refunds for inclement weather · Boating after dark prohibited · $2000 security deposit for boats, $1000 for jet skis, refunded next business day if no damage · Alcohol consumption by driver prohibited; rental terminated without refund if driver drinks · April through September
